Samira Khan: Ping — VertoMed flagged renewal invoice 123045: HSM add-on appears twice and a platform promo credit shows up twice. Can we triage?
Jon Park: Can you paste the lines? I'll pull the billing ledger.
Samira Khan: Quick snippet:
```
Invoice 123045
- Private deployment license: $48,000
- Platform fee: $8,000
- Platform promo: -$1,000
- Platform promo (duplicate): -$1,000
- HSM add-on: $2,800
- HSM add-on (duplicate): 2,800
- Support (Premium): $10,000
Total: $68,600
```
BillingBot: (automated) Case BLG-2026-802 opened. Detected duplicate HSM line and duplicate promo memo from migration import. Recommended action: consolidate and issue single credit note.
Jon Park: Metering shows only one HSM event. Duplicate came from an account-level adjustment that was merged twice. Felipe, can you approve CN for net amount?
Ops - Felipe: Approve creating CN-6082 for net credit $800 (2,800 - 1,000 - 1,000 = 800). Apply to next invoice unless customer requests refund.
Legal - Arun: Confirmed contract language allows correction. Keep message neutral: "We identified an internal billing error and issued a corrective credit note for $800; see attached corrected invoice and credit note. Contact us if you prefer a refund."
Samira Khan: I'll notify customer and reissue invoice PDF once CN is posted. Jon, please attach reconciliation breakdown here.
Jon Park: Will post reconciliation and PDFs by EOD PT. BillingBot, queue CN-6082.
BillingBot: (automated) CN-6082 queued. Case BLG-2026-802 updated.
Samira Khan: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
